Does it violate full sentence? It may be considered malformed enough? But minor typo? "so that so that" is a grammatical error, but still complete sentence? We need decide. Full sentence criterion: "well-formed full sentence." A doubled "so that" may be syntactic anomaly but not incomplete. We might not mark as violation because sentence is grammatically complete. But "well-formed"? Hmm.

Need inspect all. Many are normal. PP-011 "As a moderator, I want to have the "estimate" field filled in automatically if all estimators show the same card, so that I can accept it more quickly." Full sentence.
